title: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Insights into the Assembly of Lanthanide-Containing Clusters
claim: For the reviewed europium hydrolysis system, the observed growth pathway to Eu16 challenges the assumption that repeated octahedral units in the final structure were necessarily its assembly precursors.
explanation: The authors report a dominant sequence beginning with Eu3 species and ending in Eu16, while crystallography shows three octahedral lanthanide units in the isolated Eu16 structure.
scope: The diketonate-stabilized europium hydrolysis system discussed in the Account.
conditions: Hydrolyzed intermediates were monitored by high-resolution ESI-MS; the Eu16 product was characterized crystallographically after low-temperature crystallization.
caveats: This is a system-specific counterexample to inferring a pathway solely by deconstructing a final structure, not a universal assembly sequence.
